title: Cem Karsan: Strategic Assets Are Convex

excerpts.label: Jan 2nd regime break—strategic assets convex
excerpts.insight: Gun went off Jan 2nd—rotation from supply-side (tech/AI) to strategic assets (metals, defense, chips). In bifurcated world with supply constraints and multiple bidders, hard assets become convex for 10-15 years.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: LONG strategic assets NOW—industrial/precious metals, defense tech, semis. This is Year 1 of decade-long rotation. US catching up to China = demand explosion for bottlenecked supply.

excerpts.label: Millennial populism is structural, not cyclical
excerpts.insight: Born 1982+, only experienced 43 years of falling rates, globalization, inequality. Household formation and wealth at 45% of boomers. Can't afford homes, families. System broken—burn it down.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Demand-side economics inevitable. Rotate from tech/mag seven into consumer staples, defensives—what died in 2025 explodes in 2026. Fiscal into midterms = velocity one inflation.

excerpts.label: Trump supply-side failed—pitchforks on his lawn
excerpts.insight: Trump 2.0 tried supply-side (tax cuts, deregulation, synthetic QE), but people rejected it. Went from 'burning it down' to 'being burned down.' Karsan called it a year ago—pitchforks arrived.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Political cycle risk is real. Trump can't avoid demand-side pivot into midterms. Watch housing policy (first-time buyer checks) as populist tipping point.

excerpts.label: 62-82 parallel: midterm years brutal
excerpts.insight: Presidential years all double-digit, averaged +21.5%. Midterm years averaged -8.5%, every one had 20%+ drawdown (worst -45%). Politics only matter during populist periods—outside 62-82, no presidential cycle edge.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: 2026 midterm = expect -20%+ drawdown. Size risk accordingly. 'Shooting the generals' (leadership turnover) bearish for indices, bullish for rotation winners. Buy dips in strategic assets, NOT indices.

excerpts.label: Venezuela = cutting China's energy supply
excerpts.insight: Arrested Maduro to flip oil from China to US. When US flips supply, they cut China's access AND gain it themselves—dramatic advantage. China has limited energy, encircled by first island chain, can be blockaded.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Energy/commodity convexity accelerating. US-China resource war entering acute phase. Long copper, lithium, energy—anything China needs and US can control or redirect.

excerpts.label: Iran peace deal likely—not regime change
excerpts.insight: Middle East realignment—Saudi, Turkey, Qatar uniting against Israeli overreach and to defend Iran. US lost leverage, will settle for cutting China energy access via peace deal, not regime change.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: FADE Iran war premium. Peace deal likely next 2-3 weekends. Market pricing military conflict—wrong. Use relief rally to reload commodities, don't chase indices. This is noise, not signal.

excerpts.label: Debt refi wave + fiscal = liquidity drain
excerpts.insight: 2021 was rate low—everyone refinanced at 0.5%, 5-8 year maturity. 2026 = refi wave at 5%. Liquidity drain + fiscal spending collision = rough patch similar to 62-82 midterm years.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: STEEPENERS NOW. Long-end rates rising (fiscal + refi pressure) = multiple compression for indices. Strategic assets compound through liquidity drain. Buy vol protection, watch curve for velocity one trigger.
